title: DataEngineeringBestPracticesSkillResponse
description: Optional JSON mirror of the markdown output contract in SKILL.md (Summary, Decision, Rationale, Trade-offs, Next Steps, Template). Additional optional fields let consumers express the operating mode, principles cited, lineage, risks, and a reference to a filled data contract. All new fields are additive and may be omitted; consumers must tolerate missing fields and ignore unknown ones.

decision.description: Specific recommendation with clear action items.

tradeOffs.description: Optional rows mirroring the Trade-offs markdown table.

nextSteps.description: Numbered actions the user can execute immediately.

template.description: Path under templates/ or short name of the filled template.

mode.description: The operating mode that produced this response.

principlesCited.description: Stable principle IDs invoked by this response. Must match the IDs declared in SKILL.md (W001..W012).

risks.description: Risks the consumer must accept or mitigate before adopting the recommendation.

lineage.description: Source and target tables / topics / objects touched by this design or change.

dataContract.description: Reference to a filled or proposed data contract.

path.description: Path to the rendered contract file (e.g., 'contracts/orders_v1.yaml').

inline.description: Inline YAML body of the contract, when no file exists yet.
